analogy.rationale: Indicator dyes are inert diagnostic agents with no pharmacological target engagement; UGT1A9 annotation reflects metabolic conjugation rather than a mechanism, so they should elicit no transcriptional response. Other inert or non-signaling agents such as radiopaque media and chelating agents are the closest analogs.
